**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

The document imposes no minimum purchase or volume commitment on the Company:

- **Section 3.1** (p0019) is the only fee mechanic — a pure revenue share of 30% of Net Sales *in excess of* $11,000 per calendar month. Low or zero sales produce zero fees, so the Company pays only for actual transactions; there is no floor, minimum fee, take-or-pay or shortfall true-up needed.
- **Sections 3.2–3.3** are payment timing and reconciliation only; **Section 2.2** allocates order-processing costs, not volumes.
- Targeted searches for "minimum", "commit", "shortfall", "volume", "quota" and "purchase" returned nothing responsive anywhere in the Agreement.
- **Sections 6.1–6.2** (Exclusivity) restrict channel/brand use, not purchase volumes, so they fall outside this rule.
- **Section 4.2** Termination Payment (twelve months' Net Sales less $800,000, halved, in eight quarterly instalments, "if any") is noted in the rationale as an exit penalty properly assessed under the liquidated damages / termination-for-convenience rules — not double-flagged here as a minimum commitment.

No redline proposed, consistent with the instruction not to upgrade a bargain that already satisfies the checklist.
